question: Oda-san. Heso!! When talking Skypiea skills, pumpkins are one of them and the guy who told them about a plant called this pumpkin is a botanist named Noland, is not it? When I saw Dressrosa, they were everywhere! Could Noland also teach how to plant pumpkins on the Tontatta tribe when they meet?
answer: Yes. It is true. Perfect. Pumpkin is very nutritious. And it seems that wherever Noland goes it is rooted there. Maybe he is a man who loves nature.
name: Kamiki-kun
